projects.title: 真实开源咖啡馆模板：多页面内容与交付范围
rows: store.html 的营业时间文字须说明周一至周五 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM，且星期日 Closed。
store.html的完整营业时间列表包含Monday到Friday相同7:00 AM to 8:00 PM，并单独列Sunday Closed。只验证文字。
store.html 的星期六营业时间文字须写为 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM。
原件Saturday对应9:00 AM to 5:00 PM，与新增任务明确冲突。
store.html 的地址和电话须写明 1116 Orchard Street、Golden Valley, Minnesota、(317) 585-8468。
完整源中门店地址与电话文字均存在；不声称真实营业或号码可用。
about.html 的文字须说明咖啡馆由 Hernandez brothers 于 1987 年创立。
源段落明确Founded in 1987 by the Hernandez brothers；仅模板故事内容。
products.html 的文字内容须包含 Coffees & Teas、Bakery & Kitchen、Bulk Speciality Blends 三类产品。
三处section-heading-lower包含这三类，HTML实体&在语义文本中为普通&。
products.html 正文文案须包含完整句子 Please tell us about food allergies before ordering.
完整products.html没有该新增必需句，且任务指定正文文字，不得用未提供图像或后台推定满足。
四个页面的手机导航须在 375px 浏览器里展开和收起并且链接均能正常跳转。
只有HTML子集，未提供bootstrap脚本/CSS或浏览器观察；导航标记不能证明运行。
首页图片须真实展示一杯热咖啡并在手机上清晰且没有裁切杯口。
没有提供图像字节、样式或手机观察，img路径与alt不能证明图片内容和裁切。

projects.title: Real Modern Business template: plans, contact copy and runtime boundaries
rows: Pricing page content must list Free at $0/mo, Pro at $9/mo, and Enterprise at $49/mo.
pricing.html contains three plan headings and their displayed text prices. This is source copy, not billing execution.
Home page content must state: We care about privacy, and will never share your data.
The exact sentence occurs in the newsletter section of index.html. It proves the promised copy only, not privacy practices.
Contact form source content must label Full name, Email address, Phone number, and Message.
contact.html contains all four labels explicitly associated with input/textarea IDs. This requirement asks only for source content, not submission or rendered accessibility.
Contact page source copy must include the exact notice: Form submission successful!

The exact notice is present in contact.html in a d-none message container. The requirement is only source-copy presence; it does not assert that the notice is currently visible or conditional at runtime.
FAQ page content must include the exact question: Can I cancel my plan within 30 days?
The full FAQ HTML has generic Accordion Item questions and no requested cancellation question. This task explicitly requires the literal question, not inferred policy semantics.
FAQ page contact details must include support@domain.com.
faq.html has a mailto:support@domain.com link with that exact text. It is a template placeholder, not verified mailbox delivery.
The contact form must send a real email only after valid submission and show success after delivery.
No runtime, activation token, email service response, or independent inbox observation supplied; static success/error containers cannot establish email behavior.
Choosing Pro must actually charge $9 per month and retain a queryable subscription record.
Pricing copy and choose-plan links are not payment execution or durable subscription records; source review cannot prove those operations.

projects.title: Real Corona Admin template: static financial labels versus real operations
rows: Dashboard page source copy must include the exact table headings Payment Mode and Payment Status.
index.html contains both th texts verbatim. These are literal column headings and no real payment action is required by this criterion.
Dashboard page content must show Transfer to Paypal with the amount $236 in Transaction History.
The first transaction-history source card contains Transfer to Paypal and $236. These are public demonstration records in an open-source template, not authenticated transactions.
Login page source content must include the labels Username or email * and Password *.
pages/samples/login.html contains both labels as literal label elements. This criterion asks for source text only, not authentication behavior.
404 page content must say The page you’re looking for was not found. and Back to home.
pages/samples/error-404.html contains the exact sentence and home-link text; source text does not prove serving the right HTTP status.
Register page body copy must contain the exact sentence We never sell your personal information.
The full register.html source does not include this newly required sentence; no external dependency is assumed to supply required body copy.
Login must authenticate correct credentials and reject incorrect passwords while keeping different users isolated.
Static public template HTML cannot establish server-side authentication, password checks, sessions, or per-user authorization.
Transfer to Paypal must actually execute a $236 payment and verify its provider transaction status.
The dashboard is only static source copy and sample amounts. No real payment/provider evidence is supplied, and no money-moving operation is attempted in this evaluation.
Registration must persist a new account and keep that account queryable after a server restart.
No account service, persistence, server execution or independent readback supplied; register markup is insufficient.
